get_config.description: Read the typed, user-facing system configuration. Internal schema, profile override, module, and arbitrary path access is excluded.

params.keys: Optional allowlisted configuration keys. Omit to return every user-facing key.

set_config.description: Atomically update one typed, allowlisted system configuration field. The result reports whether an application restart is required.

params.change: Exactly one typed allowlisted configuration change.

reload_config.description: Ask the running desktop runtime to reload the system configuration and return its authoritative health result.

get_config_health.description: Get the running desktop runtime configuration health and last-known-good status.

get_machine_info.description: Probe the live runtime capacity source for CPU, memory, swap, and current availability.

validate_config.description: Validate every typed user-facing configuration field and cross-field resource-cap constraint.

backup_database.description: Create a consistent SQLite backup through the running desktop database owner.

list_database_backups.description: List database backups available to the running desktop database owner.

restore_database.description: Validate and stage a database backup for atomic restore before the next application database startup. Requires restart of all application database processes.

params.backup_filename: Backup filename returned by list_database_backups. Arbitrary filesystem paths are rejected.
params.confirm: Must be true to confirm staging this destructive restore.

set_provider_defaults.description: Set or clear the validated default data provider for a supported market domain. The shared value is visible to the desktop Settings and Tool Sweep provider picker.

params.provider_id: Validated provider ID, or null to clear the default

create_conversation.description: Create an AI Strategy Studio conversation in the same user-owned shared store used by the Guide chat.

update_conversation.description: Update typed, user-editable fields on an owned AI Strategy Studio conversation.

params.title: New conversation title
params.preview: New preview text, or null to clear it
params.strategy_rules: Strategy rules, or null to clear them

search_conversations.description: Search owned, non-deleted conversations by title and message content, newest first.

params.query: Non-empty title or message search text

add_message.description: Add one typed message to an owned conversation and update its message and token counters atomically.

params.token_count: Token count contributed by this message
params.metadata: Typed JSON metadata persisted with the message

delete_message.description: Permanently delete one owned conversation message and update counters atomically. DESTRUCTIVE: requires confirm=true.

params.confirm: Must be true to confirm permanent message deletion

get_startup_audit.description: Get the most recent persisted desktop startup audit, or null when no startup has been recorded.

list_startup_audits.description: List persisted desktop startup audits in deterministic newest-first order.

get_credit_status.description: Get the signed-in account credit balance and usage totals from the authoritative StratCraft account service.

get_rate_limit_status.description: Get the live desktop free-tier strategy-generation rate-limit state without consuming quota. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running.

get_distribution_info.description: Get the installed application distribution and whether it is the public release. Works with Electron stopped.

get_consent_status.description: Get the persisted crash-reporting and analytics consent state and whether consent has been recorded. Works with Electron stopped.

set_consent.description: Persist crash-reporting and analytics consent through the same cross-process-safe store used by the desktop Settings page.

params.crashes: Whether crash reporting is consented to
params.analytics: Whether product analytics are consented to

get_app_info.description: Get the application version, canonical user-data path, and research-mode state. Works with Electron stopped.

get_server_status.description: Get live Electron Service API and C++ toolchain readiness. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running.

get_marketplace_registry.description: Get the marketplace registry, download statistics, and installed-plugin versions from the same live service used by the Marketplace page. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running.

params.force_refresh: Bypass the registry cache and fetch the latest catalog

get_marketplace_plugin_details.description: Get marketplace metadata and the installed version for one plugin. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running.

check_plugin_updates.description: Check installed marketplace plugins for available version updates. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running.

activate_license.description: Validate and securely store a third-party plugin license key. The key is never returned. T2 persistent change: requires confirm=true and the Electron desktop app.

params.plugin_id: Plugin ID whose license will be activated
params.license_key: License key to validate and store securely; never returned
params.confirm: Must be true to allow secure persistent license storage

get_license_status.description: Get non-secret license status for one or more plugins. Never returns stored license keys. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running.

remove_license.description: Permanently remove a plugin license key from secure storage. T2 destructive operation: requires confirm=true and the Electron desktop app.

params.plugin_id: Plugin ID whose stored license key will be removed
params.confirm: Must be true to permanently remove the stored license key

check_marketplace_entitlement.description: Check the signed-in account entitlement for one marketplace plugin using the desktop authentication session. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running.

check_marketplace_entitlements_batch.description: Check the signed-in account entitlements for a non-empty list of marketplace plugins. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running.

params.plugin_ids: Non-empty list of marketplace plugin IDs

get_entitlement_audit_log.description: Get recent entitlement check, execution, and toggle decisions from the live entitlement enforcer. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running.

params.limit: Maximum number of newest audit entries to return

list_strategies.description: List active strategies/algorithms stored in StratCraft, optionally filtered by strategy type or signal-source classification. Returns id, code, name, type, signal source, and creation time.

params.limit: Maximum number of strategies to return
params.signal_source_prefix: Optional classification_metadata signal_source prefix filter, such as indicator_detector for Regime Detector strategies

get_strategy.description: Get detailed information about a specific strategy by ID, including classification metadata and strategy rules.

delete_strategy.description: Soft-delete strategies by ID or by filter (cockpit type / signal source). System algorithms are always protected. Provide either id for single delete OR filter params for batch delete.

params.id: Strategy ID to delete (from list_strategies). Mutually exclusive with strategy_type/signal_source_prefix.
params.strategy_type: Filter by strategy_type (9=analysis/regime, 3=entry_signal, 6=exit/risk_override, 7=precondition/watchlist, 1=execution). Used for batch delete.
params.signal_source_prefix: Filter by signal_source prefix in classification_metadata (e.g. indicator_detector, indicator_entry, risk_override, aiLibero, aiStudio, llmtrader, kronos_prediction). Used for batch delete.

start_generation_session.description: Start a page-scoped strategy-generation session in the same live GenerationService used by the desktop. The selected LLM provider, model, and locale are injected from the authoritative session context. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running.

params.page_id: Stable Strategy Builder page identifier whose generation slot owns this run
params.strategy_name: Strategy name shown in generation state
params.start_endpoint: Ratified generation start endpoint used by the corresponding desktop page
params.poll_endpoint: Ratified generation status endpoint paired with start_endpoint
params.request_body: JSON generation request defined by the selected Strategy Builder workflow

cancel_generation_session.description: Cancel the in-flight generation session for a Strategy Builder page through the live GenerationService. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running.

params.page_id: Strategy Builder page identifier whose active generation should be cancelled

get_generation_state.description: Read the authoritative page-scoped generation slot observed by the desktop, including status, result, error, strategy name, and start time. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running.

params.page_id: Strategy Builder page identifier whose generation state should be returned

generate_from_catalog.description: Generate, validate, and persist a C++ ABI v2 strategy from the Strategy Catalog through the same live owning operation used by the desktop. The selected LLM provider, model, and locale contract is preserved. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running.

start_batch_generation.description: Start serial Strategy Builder batch generation through the live batch owner, with progressive de-duplication and the authoritative selected LLM execution context. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running.

params.regime: Strategy regime used for every item in the batch
params.indicators: Non-empty indicator names used by each generated strategy
params.preference: Optional generation preference applied to the batch

cancel_batch_generation.description: Cancel the active Strategy Builder batch generation run through the same live batch owner used by the desktop. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running.

get_batch_generation_state.description: Get the authoritative state and per-item outcomes of the current or most recent batch strategy generation run. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running.

list_deleted_strategies.description: List soft-deleted strategies in the recycle bin, newest deletion first.

params.limit: Maximum number of deleted strategies to return
params.offset: Number of deleted strategies to skip

restore_strategy.description: Restore one soft-deleted strategy from the recycle bin.

purge_strategy.description: Permanently delete one strategy that is already in the recycle bin. DESTRUCTIVE: requires confirm=true and cannot be undone.

params.confirm: Must be true to confirm permanent deletion

list_audit_entries.description: List Strategy Builder audit entries using the same signal-source, LLM, rating, ordering, and limit contract as the desktop audit view.

params.limit: Maximum number of audit entries to return

get_audit_by_algorithm.description: Get the newest Strategy Builder audit entry for an algorithm or signal ID.

list_backtest_results.description: List backtest results with key metrics (PnL, Sharpe, drawdown, win rate). Returns summary without full trade/equity data.

params.limit: Maximum number of results to return

get_backtest_result.description: Get full backtest result by task ID, including trades and equity curve data.

list_factors.description: List all factors/indicators stored in StratCraft with IC and Sharpe metrics.

params.limit: Maximum number of factors to return

list_signal_sources.description: List all signal sources registered in StratCraft Quant Lab.

params.limit: Maximum number of signal sources to return

generate_strategy.description: Generate a C++ ABI v2 regime-detector strategy through the direct nona_server Architecture V3 path. Use canonical regime and indicator catalog slugs. Omit strategy_name to use the shared default and storage collision policy. Returns algorithm ID and resolved strategy name on success.

params.regime: Canonical regime: trend, range, consolidation, oscillation, or bespoke
params.indicators: Strategy indicator catalog slugs returned by list_strategy_indicators
params.strategy_name: Optional strategy name; omit to use the shared default and storage collision suffix policy
params.persona: Optional persona constraint ID; omit unless the user explicitly selected one

list_personas.description: List available trading personas for strategy generation constraints. Personas define trading style, risk profile, and strategy constraints.

generate_kronos_strategy.description: Generate a Kronos AI time-series prediction strategy. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running. Returns algorithmId and strategyName on success.

params.strategy_name: Optional strategy name; omit to use the shared default and storage collision suffix policy
params.start_time: Start time in ISO format (only for custom time_range)

generate_entry_signal.description: Generate an entry signal strategy using LLM. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running. Returns algorithmId and strategyName on success.

params.strategy_name: Name for the generated entry signal strategy
params.indicators: List of technical indicators (e.g., RSI, MACD, EMA, Bollinger, Stochastic, ADX)
params.preference: Free-text preference/instructions for the LLM (e.g., "RSI(14) overbought/oversold crossover")
params.auto_reverse: Auto-generate short conditions as inverse of long

generate_exit_strategy.description: Generate an exit/risk-override strategy using LLM. Supports circuit_breaker, time_limit, drawdown_limit, and indicator_guard rules. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running.

params.strategy_name: Name for the generated exit strategy

generate_ai_libero_strategy.description: Generate an AI Libero standalone agent strategy using LLM. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running. Returns algorithmId and strategyName on success.

params.strategy_name: Optional strategy name; omit to use the shared default and storage collision suffix policy
params.prompt: Trading strategy description for the LLM agent (min 10 chars)
params.preset_mode: Trader preset mode defining risk/frequency constraints
params.indicators: Technical indicators for the agent (e.g., RSI, MACD, EMA)
params.lookback_bars: Bars of history sent to LLM (20-200)

generate_ai_studio_strategy.description: Generate a strategy using AI Studio (conversational strategy authoring). Extracts trading rules from a named strategy, trader, or concept description, then generates C++ code. No regime or indicator selection needed -- the server self-routes via Fishbone modules. Returns algorithmId and strategyName on success.

params.strategy_name: Optional strategy name; omit to use the shared default and storage collision suffix policy
params.description: What to generate: a strategy concept, named strategy, or trader style to extract and codify (min 10 chars)
params.indicators: Optional technical indicators (e.g., RSI, MACD, EMA). Usually not needed -- the server extracts indicators from the description.

start_ai_studio_session.description: Start a new AI Studio conversational session. Sends a strategy description to the server and returns session_id, strategy_rules (extracted trading rules), available_actions (what the user can do next), and metadata including fishbone_module (which module the server routed to). Use this for multi-turn strategy authoring where you need to iteratively refine rules before generating code.

params.description: The strategy concept, named strategy, or trader style to explore (e.g., "extract Larry Williams strategy", "decompose Turtle Trading rules")
params.strategy_name: Optional strategy name; omit to let the server derive one

continue_ai_studio_session.description: Continue an existing AI Studio session with a follow-up message. Pass the session_id from start_ai_studio_session and optionally the current_strategy_rules from the previous response. The server maintains conversation history per session_id. Use this to refine strategy rules, add conditions, or ask clarifying questions before generating code.

params.message: Follow-up message to the AI Studio session (e.g., "add a trailing stop at 2%", "what indicators does this use?")
params.current_strategy_rules: Strategy rules from the previous turn response; pass them back to maintain rule state across turns

run_ai_studio_action.description: Run a gated action on an AI Studio session. The action must be present in the available_actions array from the previous session response. Actions: generate_code (generates C++ strategy code from the defined rules), save_strategy (persists the generated strategy to the database, returns algorithmId), run_backtest (not yet supported). For save_strategy, the strategy is classified with strategy_type=1 and signal_source=aiStudio, identical to the batch path.

params.action: Action to run; must be listed in the previous response available_actions array
params.current_strategy_rules: Strategy rules from the previous turn; required for accurate code generation
params.strategy_name: Strategy name for persistence; defaults to "AI Studio Strategy" if omitted

run_backtest.description: Run a backtest on a stored algorithm. Requires the Electron desktop app to be running. Returns taskId for status tracking.

params.algorithm_id: Algorithm ID from generate_strategy, generate_entry_signal, or generate_exit_strategy
params.start_date: Start date in ISO format (e.g., 2023-01-01). Defaults to 2 years ago.
params.end_date: End date in ISO format (e.g., 2024-12-31). Defaults to today.
params.dry_run: Run in dry-run mode: stubs LLM/Kronos API calls, returns estimated call counts instead of real PnL

get_backtest_status.description: Get the status of a running or completed backtest task. Returns status (preparing, queued, running, completed, failed, cancelled).

alpha_factory_add_signals.description: Add signals to the active Alpha Factory config by ID. Accepts signal-definition IDs (from list_signal_runs / list_signal_definitions) or persisted signal IDs (persistedSignalId) -- definition IDs are resolved to the persisted signal via fingerprint. Idempotent and self-verifying: adding an id already present is a safe no-op, reported per-id in results[] with outcome already_present_input_id / already_present_resolved_id plus the matching chip name and persistedSignalId. DO NOT load_alpha_factory_config first to check membership -- call add directly and read each result outcome. Returns results[] (one outcome per id, with resolvedVia) plus derived counters and totalSignals. T2 (mutates active config).

params.signal_ids: Signal ids to add -- accepts a union: signal-definition id (from list_signal_runs / list_signal_definitions) OR persisted signal id (the persistedSignalId projected on scoreboard/definition rows). Definition ids resolve to the persisted signal via fingerprint. The result reports which resolution fired per id (resolvedVia).

strategies.deleteExclusive: Cannot combine id with strategy_type/signal_source_prefix. Use one mode.

strategies.deleteInvalidId: id must be a positive integer.
strategies.deleteAlreadyDeleted: Strategy with id=%s is already deleted.
strategies.deleteSystemProtected: Strategy with id=%s is a system algorithm and cannot be deleted.
